reason: The administration itself is documented (Joy Vipinchandra Bhatt of Moore JVB appointed administrator with effect from 24 March 2025; directors' powers over assets ceased; creditors' claims due by 23 April 2025: Business Daily, Citizen Digital, Techweez), but no source gives the founder's, the company's, the administrator's or a court's account of why the company entered administration or who made the appointment, so the decision at the heart of the episode cannot be told or attributed. Eric Muli is quoted only as confirming acquisition talks and declining to comment on 'the ongoing court process'. The matter was still before the High Court (an October 2025 order on who may collect receivables; a ruling on the administration scheduled for 30 April 2026, per The Kenya Times, March 2026) and no report of the outcome could be found. Reports of unpaid staff and suppliers, and of a $5 million loan sought after the administrator's appointment, cannot be told fairly until the court rules. Other episodes (the 2022 Sky.Garden purchase, the 2023 Republic crowdfund) lead into the same unresolved administration. Three searches used.
